description: This file defines the GatewayNodeSession actor that manages WebSocket connections, handles event dispatching, and processes invoke requests for a node gateway in an OpenClaw-related project. It includes URL normalization, request timeout handling, and event handling mechanisms.

classes.name: GatewayNodeSession
classes.description: An actor that manages WebSocket connection lifecycle, event handling, and request routing for the node gateway.

methods.name: invokeWithTimeout
methods.description: Handles invoking a request with an optional timeout, returning a response or timeout error.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection with provided parameters, setting up necessary callbacks.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Shuts down the connection and resets the connection state.

methods.name: refreshNodeCanvasCapability
methods.description: Requests a refresh of the node's canvas capability and updates the stored canvas host URL.
